description: Search Slovenian statutes and regulations by keyword. Searches FTS-indexed provisions from PIS (pisrs.si). Use document_id to narrow to a specific statute. Supports temporal queries via as_of_date. Returns provision text snippets with BM25 relevance ranking.

as_of_date.description: ISO date to query historical versions (e.g. "2020-01-01"). Returns provisions valid at that date.

document_id.description: Document ID to restrict search to a specific statute (e.g. "ZVOP-2", "KZ-1")

query.description: Search terms (Slovenian or English). Examples: "osebni podatki", "varstvo okolja", "kaznivo dejanje"

status.description: Filter by status: in_force, repealed, amended

name: search_legislation
